candidate_definition.name: point_in_time_wu_observation_envelope_last_v1
candidate_definition.kind: deterministic captured-input replay counterfactual; no fitted parameter
candidate_definition.snapshot_order: captured_at_utc ascending within each market-day, original replay file position as the stable tie-break
candidate_definition.point_in_time_rule: At snapshot t, use the current replay payload and only replay snapshots with captured_at_utc strictly earlier than t. Assert max prior captured_at_utc < t and emit the receipt.
candidate_definition.row_update: Retain every previously observed timestamp. If the same timestamp is reported again, retain the temperature in the most recent payload at or before t.
candidate_definition.cutoff_rule: Use the historical captured producer rule: greatest configured cutoff no later than wall clock and no later than the envelope latest observation minute; use the wall cutoff if no cutoff is eligible.
candidate_definition.fallback_rule: If the envelope has no cutoff-eligible WU row, leave the captured served high_so_far and its non-WU fallback path unchanged.
candidate_definition.replay_change_scope: Replace only the captured WU history row series with the point-in-time envelope and let the captured model path recompute cutoff_hour, high_so_far, downstream features, and probabilities. All other captured inputs, model identity, calibration, floor, and probability-mass rules remain unchanged.
